changes.summary: Schema description documents GENESYSCLOUD_OUTBOUND_DNCLIST_UNMANAGED_ENTRIES for managing entries outside Terraform.

When GENESYSCLOUD_OUTBOUND_DNCLIST_UNMANAGED_ENTRIES is unset, refresh loads all RDS list entries into state even if entries are omitted from configuration; when set, refresh only loads entries when configuration declares a non-empty entries block and otherwise clears entries in state.

When GENESYSCLOUD_OUTBOUND_DNCLIST_UNMANAGED_ENTRIES is unset, updates reconcile API entries whenever HasChange("entries") without skipping omitted entries blocks as in v1.87.0; when set, apply only reconciles when configuration includes at least one entry row.
When the simple external contact block-label environment toggle is enabled, export skips organization lookups and block labels may omit the organization name prefix.
